issues.rule: MDC-026/MDC-045 unknown is not measured zero
issues.detail: summarizeTireDifferentialDrift always maps TIRE_CORNERS at lib:334, even when no usable rows exist, producing zero slopes/confidence/offset and a selected imbalance corner. Thus slopeBars.length stays four and the slope chart's empty condition never detects a resolved empty or fully unusable history. deriveDataState.hasData is true for [] (dataState:194-195), so KPI lines 119/126 can report None detected/zero imbalance despite absent usable evidence.
issues.fix: Gate inferred measurements and slope presentation on usable evidence, keeping genuine zero distinct from unavailable and insufficient evidence. Preserve raw-row/sample counts, all four sections and evidence thresholds; do not alter inference formulas during presentation work.

issues.detail: VehicleOperationalBrief is not passed retained or error, so its adapter can label retained history Returned evidence even while surrounding VehicleSourceContent shows a stale warning. Adapter:30-37 already supports retained status.
issues.fix: Pass the source-derived retained condition to the existing brief; keep usable metrics and section warnings visible without promoting initial errors into retained data.

states.verification: All state descriptions are source inspection, not mounted state tests.

visualIssues.detail: Leak-corner bars are forced to chartTokens.series[3], which is saturated red (#ef4444 at tokens.ts:401) and also the ordinary rear-right color at page:36. A leak corner and a non-leaking rear-right bar can therefore share the same special-highlight color. No explicit chart text mark distinguishes the leak bar itself; interpretation badges elsewhere do.
visualIssues.fix: Retain stable four-corner identities, but represent leak emphasis with a restrained semantic cue plus text/annotation rather than ambiguous saturated recoloring. Reuse existing chart tokens and annotations; do not replace the global palette or persisted user choices.

architectureIssues.detail: Page ignores useRangeState and always requests the hook's rolling 30-day start-only window. Assigned route is absent from inspected RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS (workspaceScope.ts:23-77). This dated analysis cannot follow the shared View settings range or a selected end bound.
architectureIssues.fix: Integrate the existing header-owned range through a typed acquisition contract and register this exact route; preserve a deliberate existing analysis default, rolling/custom/timezone semantics, robust fitting requirements and server-wide filtering. Confirm backend end-bound support before claiming it; do not add local selectors or client-only truncation.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-044 locale/date policy and stable data identity
architectureIssues.detail: Residual time is converted immediately to a browser-default month/day/hour string, omitting year, minutes and explicit selected timezone/locale. This same abbreviated string is the exported accessible data column. Distinct observations can share labels and original ms identity is lost from residualSeries, though it remains in the pure summary.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep the original timestamp in presentation rows and use the existing date/time formatting owner for axis versus complete tooltip/data-table text, honoring saved preferences without changing source/cache timestamps or observations.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-044 localized labels with runtime unit interpolation
architectureIssues.detail: Slope column embeds unitPrefs.pressure only in the translation fallback, unlike normal named interpolation. If a catalog value exists without equivalent interpolation, preference changes need not update this label. Catalog content was not inspected, so an actual translated mismatch is unverified.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the canonical translation key with a named unit parameter, coordinate catalog ownership only if the existing key lacks it, and verify all enabled locales while retaining pressure/day meaning.
